name: celery-payments
written: 2026-10-08, by reading config/celery.py, ledger/services.py, ledger/views.py and the three tasks.py at the pinned commit. process_payment() chains debit_wallet into write_ledger_entry (the debit's returned dict is the ledger task's argument); notify_users() fans send_notification out over chunks with a group and never gathers the results; task_routes sends each task to its queue; the two money tasks retry with back-off and, when retries run out, re-send themselves to the dead_letter queue. The view's docstring says wallet -> ledger -> notification, but in the code the notification is fed by the request's values, not by the ledger task, so there is no edge from write_ledger_entry to send_notification.

pipelines.title: The payment canvas
fans: notify_users: group(send_notification.s(chunk) for chunk in chunks(...)) with no join
error_lanes: debit_wallet: retry (autoretry_for, back-off 5, 5 retries), then dead_letter
write_ledger_entry: retry (autoretry_for, back-off 5, 5 retries), then dead_letter
